sources.title: Alexander Pedals Hot Pink Drive | Effects Database
sources.excerpt: Hot Pink Drive is described as a limited 2018, hand-assembled and very pink release. Controls are Level, Drive, passive Bass/Treble voiced like a British amplifier, and an active midrange Contour filter with up to 18dB of boost or scoop. It uses true-bypass switching with a latching relay and soft-touch footswitch, remembers settings, accepts up to 18V, and uses no battery.

sources.title: Hot. Pink. Drive. - Alexander Pedals manual
sources.excerpt: The manual documents Level, Drive, Bass/Treble, and Contour controls, true-bypass soft-touch switching, settings memory, 2015 production limited to thirty pieces worldwide, and 9-18V DC operation.
